title: Passive Self-Leveling Cup Holder
subtitle: A 3D-printed dual-axis gimbal that keeps a drink upright on a moving wheelchair — no motors, no sensors, no code.

decision.question: Should the cup sit on top of the leveling ring, or hang below it?

rejected.option: Cup seated on top of the gimbal ring
rejected.why: Puts the mass above the pivot, so the whole assembly wobbles and the cup can slide out under sudden motion

chosen.option: Cup suspended below the rotation center, with the base doubling as counterweight
chosen.why: Gravity does the correcting work: a low center of mass returns the cup to level on its own, and the vertical frame supports the cup along its full height

decision.quote: The stabilization is not controlled — it is designed into the geometry.
